en: A black-and-white postcard showing a large modernist multi‑storey institutional building with rows of identical rectangular windows. In the foreground is a sloped dirt area, a stone retaining wall with stairs, and a low entrance structure supported by concrete pillars. There are a couple of bicycles near the entrance. Printed white text appears at the bottom identifying the location and photo credit in Swedish.
